verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
Do you feel the world is broken? (We do)
Do you feel the shadows deepen? (We do)
But do you know that all the dark won’t stop
The light from getting through? (We do)
Do you wish that you could see it all made new?
We do

verse.name: v2a
verse.lines:
Is all creation groaning? (It is)
Is a new creation coming? (It is)
Is the glory of the Lord to be
The light within our midst? (It is)
Is it good that we remind ourselves of this?
It is

verse.name: c1a
verse.lines:
Is anyone worthy? Is anyone whole?
Is anyone able to break the seal
And open the scroll?
The Lion of Judah who conquered the grave
He is David’s root and the Lamb who died
To ransom the slave

verse.name: c1b
verse.lines:
Is He worthy? Is He worthy
Of all blessing and honor and glory?
Is He worthy of this?
He is

verse.name: v2b
verse.lines:
Does the Father truly love us? (He does)
Does the Spirit move among us? (He does)
And does Jesus our Messiah
Hold forever those He loves? (He does)
Does our God intend to dwell again with us?
He does

verse.name: c2a
verse.lines:
Is anyone worthy? Is anyone whole?
Is anyone able to break the seal
And open the scroll?
The Lion of Judah who conquered the grave
He is David’s root and the Lamb who died
To ransom the slave

verse.name: c2b
verse.lines:
From ev’ry people and tribe, ev’ry nation and tongue
He has made us a kingdom of priests to God
To reign with the Son

verse.name: c2c
verse.lines:
Is He worthy? Is He worthy
Of all blessing and honor and glory?
Is He worthy? Is He worthy?
Is He worthy of this?

verse.name: e1
verse.lines:
He is! He is! He is! He is!
He is worthy, He is worthy
Of all blessing and honor and glory
He is worthy of this
He is
